next_step: Schedule cost-optimization workshop; deliver Dedicated pricing & 2-week hosted POC plan.
notes:
Account summary: Driftline is a mid-market product analytics SaaS targeting product teams (B2B). Evaluating Redwood as primary inference provider for in-app assistant + knowledge search. Prefers to validate on Hosted first (speed to market) then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost control. They are cost-sensitive but care heavily about latency for support flows.

Recent timeline (bulleted CRM-style):
- 2026-02-10: Initial inbound via signup + product questionnaire. AE intro (Aisha).
- 2026-02-18: Discovery call (ff_2026-02-18_0931). Confirmed primary workloads: support chatbot (low-latency), doc-search embeddings for KB, reranking for top-N.
- 2026-02-24: Demo of Hosted API w/ streaming; SE (Marco) ran quick lat/throughput checks. Notes: p50 goal ~120-200ms for short responses, p95 <= 800ms; throughput estimated 60-120 reqs/s peak.
- 2026-03-02: Deep-dive call re: cost and architecture (ff_2026-03-02_1410). Requested benchmarking plan + cost modelling.
- 2026-03-05: Security questionnaire submitted (drive:/security/driftline-security-faq.pdf). Legal asked about data residency and audit logs.

POC / Eval plan agreed: 2-week Hosted POC measuring both quality and unit economics, then a Dedicated proposal if numbers favorable. POC scope: instrument token-level cost, per-route batching simulation, prefix cache for KB queries, and a small rerank experiment to measure model/latency tradeoffs.

Cost optimization workshop items (requested):
- Walk through batching strategy: target dynamic batching with 5-15ms enqueue window for support flow. Show cost/latency tradeoff curves.
- Prefix/KV caching: demo cache hit-rate impact on tokens saved for common KB queries.
- Quantization profiles: evaluate int8 vs int4 safe profiles for reranking model; measure quality delta with A/B on held-out prompts.
- Unit economics deck: per-route cost breakdown, amortized GPU cost, recommended batching/cold-start settings.

Customer priorities & constraints (voice-of-customer):
- "We need predictable monthly spend and clear per-conversation cost."
- Latency first for chat; embeddings can tolerate higher latency but need stable throughput for nightly indexing.
- Compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs and KMS integration mandatory.
- Region/residency: prefer US & EU tenant options for customer data; want explicit residency for EU enterprise customers.

Technical notes (SE):
- Avg token length expected: 120 tokens for chat, 600 tokens for doc-search embeddings requests (batched).
- Target throughput for Dedicated sizing: baseline 80 reqs/s with 256-token avg, burst to 250 reqs/s.
- Sensitive to reranking latency; want fallback to smaller model for tail degradation. Plan to use smart routing and automatic fallback.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver Hosted POC plan + measurement template (Aisha/Marco)  due 2026-03-12 (action).
- Schedule 90-min cost-optimization workshop with product + infra (invite sent, proposed 2026-03-16).
- Provide Dedicated sizing + two pricing options (monthly commit vs burst-capacity) by 2026-03-20.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal: final sign-off on data residency language and KMS integration (SEC-1182).
- Procurement: finance cycle closes mid-May; need pricing to align with May procurement window.
- Integration: whether on-prem connectors needed for upcoming enterprise pilot (customer asked to confirm).

Stubs/links: pricing deck & hosted POC are in drive:/pocs/driftline/hosted-poc-plan.md and drive:/deals/driftline/pricing-deck-v2. Gmail threads reference follow-ups (gmail:thread-175e0f). Jira tickets: INF-3421 (latency regression debug during demo), SEC-1182 (KMS & residency follow-up).

Sales notes (tone): warm account, product-led trial matured to SE-led evaluation. Strong win if we can demonstrate >=30% token cost reduction via batching+cache w/o quality loss.
